t: Magnusson 60G wood sanding roll is designed for dry hand-sanding and efficient stock removal. Measuring 5000mm by 115mm, the coarse aluminium oxide sanding roll provides excellent durability for demanding tasks. Ideal for carpenters and DIYers working on hardwood and softwood projects. The strong E-weight paper backing offers reliability and flexibility when smoothing rough timber surfaces. Features an open-coat design which reduces clogging for a cleaner finish and professional results. The heavy-duty abrasive roll delivers a consistent, professional finish on flat surfaces and shaped profiles.
b: Tough Paper Backing Resists Wear & Tearing
Fits Hand Blocks with Standard 115mm Width
Reduces Clogging & Dust Accumulation with Open Coat Design
Provides Efficient Cutting Action for Trade Carpentry Tasks
Sanding Paper Works on Hardwood & Softwood
